{"id":1516865502,"question_id":3,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1737551445,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1516865502/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int lengthOfLongestSubstring(string s) {\n        int charIndex[256] = {-1};  // Initialize all to -1 (not seen)\n        int maxLength = 0, i = 0;\n        if(s.size() == 1 ||s == \" \") return 1;\n\n        for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {\n            if (charIndex[s[j]] != -1) {\n                i = max(charIndex[s[j]] + 1, i);  // Move left pointer to skip duplicate\n            }\n            charIndex[s[j]] = j;  // Update character position\n            maxLength = max(maxLength, j - i + 1);\n        }\n\n        return maxLength;\n    }\n};\n","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-substring-without-repeating-characters","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":236}
